pages.text: The Chronocortex can grow a spyglass that looks $(o)backwards$(). Hold it to my eye and the present fades; what stood here before shows through, a sepia ghost.$(br2)It burns $(l)Time$(): its own store first (pour a Stasis Ampoule onto it), then my pool. A dram every two seconds, more for deeper looks.

pages.title: How Far Back
pages.text: Sneak and use it to change the setting.$(br)$(l)Echo$(): hours. Nothing yet.$(br)$(l)Decades$(): ruined laboratories with their lights still on.$(br)$(l)Centuries$(): older ruins, whole.$(br2)Something tells me it can see further still, if the Chronocortex grows.
